posts.question:
🧒 Bonus: grown-ups leak too. Squeeze one fist really hard and the other hand often tenses a little: the harder the job, the more of the copy slips through.

posts.question:

posts.question:

posts.question:

posts.question:

posts.question:
🪐 Bonus: a day on Saturn lasts only about 10.7 hours, and it spins so fast that it bulges: it's about a tenth wider through the middle than from pole to pole.
Did you guess sink or float? 🛁

posts.title: The Planet Where It Rains GLASS Sideways ☔
posts.question:
🌍 Bonus: a year on HD 189733b lasts just 2.2 Earth days, and one side probably always faces its star, so it never gets dark there.

👍 Bonus: doctors call it the Linburg–Comstock variation. For most people it's harmless, but in some musicians it aches, and surgeons can free the two tendons.

posts.question:

posts.title: Lightning Is 5x HOTTER Than the Sun's Surface ⚡
posts.question:
🌩️ Bonus: count the seconds between the flash and the thunder and divide by 3: that's roughly how many kilometres away it struck (divide by 5 for miles). And when thunder roars, go indoors!
Thunder or flash: which scares you more? ⚡

posts.title: Make a Duck Hand. Can You SPREAD Your Fingers? 🦆
posts.question:
🦆 Bonus: doctors splint injured hands in this exact duck shape, so the knuckle straps stay long.

posts.question:

posts.question:
🌉 Bonus: ever heard a clunk-clunk driving over a bridge? Those gaps are expansion joints: bridges stretch in summer too, so they need room.

posts.title: Your HONEY Could Outlive You 🍯
posts.question:
🍼 Bonus: never give honey to a baby under 1. It can carry botulism spores that a grown-up's gut handles but a baby's can't.

posts.title: Why Can't You Say "M" With Your Mouth OPEN? 👄
posts.question:
👄 Bonus: ventriloquists can't make a real M either. They swap in an N, and your brain hears the M.
